title: Manage Money Well
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / for example

dialogue.t: Amy, how do you manage your pocket money?
I keep my money in a jar.
No. I save some every week.
Can you give me an example?
For example, I get twenty yuan and I save five yuan.
I also sell my old books to my friends.

vocab: manage 管理 · pocket money 零花钱 · jar 罐子 · save 储蓄 · for example 例如 · sell 卖

questions.stem: Where does Amy keep her money?
questions.why: I keep my money in a jar.

questions.stem: How much does Amy save from twenty yuan?
questions.why: I get twenty yuan and I save five yuan.

questions.stem: What does Amy sell to her friends?
questions.why: I also sell my old books to my friends.
